name: Lightning
desc: Branching lightning bolts re-forked on every strike over a roiling storm sky, with a strobe-safe partial afterglow and continuous rain — strikes fire on strong bass or every few bars, in storm, tesla-violet, scraperboard-engraving, or cyan blueprint renderings.

density.doc: rain amount + cloud presence + branch count

x.doc: strike origin x / rain wind lean

style.doc: render philosophy: blue-white glow bolt over dark cloud / violet-cyan crackling tesla / scraperboard etched pale strokes with hatching / non-representational cyan blueprint vectors with measurement ticks

act.doc: multi-minute program: scattered occasional bolts / frontline steady rhythm / supercell intensity builds with the section arc
